notes: Sourced from Powersoft's official current datasheet "Quattrocanali DSP Series" (PS_Quattrocanali-DSPONLY_DS_EN.pdf, covers the 1204/2404/4804/8804 power tiers on one sheet), linked from the product page https://www.powersoft.com/en/products/install-amps/quattrocanali-series/quattrocanali-4804-dsp. This is the base "Quattrocanali 4804 DSP" variant (analog I/O + Fast Ethernet control only). Powersoft also currently sells "4804 DSP+" (adds AES67 audio-over-IP) and "4804 DSP+D" (adds Dante) variants which add networked-audio capability, likely on the same RJ45 — not confirmed/included here since the base datasheet doesn't cover them. Input and output audio are each a single pluggable Euroblock/Phoenix terminal-block header (Phoenix MC 1.5/12-ST-3.81 for the 4 analog inputs combined incl. main+aux switching; Phoenix PC 5/8-STF1-7.62 for the 4 outputs combined) rather than 4 physically separate connector shells — modeled here as one port per channel for wiring clarity. AC inlet is IEC 60320 C20 (20A), which mates with a C19 cord; mapped to the closest provided enum "iec-c19" (the C19/C20 high-current family) rather than the lower-current C13/C14 "iec". An older Powersoft marketing page mentioned a built-in RS-485 remote-control interface, but the current datasheet's Networking section and front-panel diagram show only Fast Ethernet/ArmoniaPlus, so no separate RS-485 physical port was included. Unit is 1U, 483 x 44.5 x 358 mm, 7 kg.

ports.name: Input 1

ports.name: Input 2
ports.note: Analog audio input, channel 2; same shared 12-pin Euroblock as Input 1/3/4

ports.name: Input 3
ports.note: Analog audio input, channel 3; same shared 12-pin Euroblock as Input 1/2/4

ports.name: Input 4
ports.note: Analog audio input, channel 4; same shared 12-pin Euroblock as Input 1/2/3

ports.name: Output 1
ports.note: Speaker/line output, channel 1 (Hi-Z 70V/100V or Lo-Z from 2ohm, bridgeable in pairs); shares a single 8-pin Phoenix PC 5/8-STF1-7.62 pluggable terminal block with outputs 2-4

ports.name: Output 2
ports.note: Speaker/line output, channel 2; same shared 8-pin Euroblock as Output 1/3/4

ports.name: Output 3
ports.note: Speaker/line output, channel 3; same shared 8-pin Euroblock as Output 1/2/4

ports.name: Output 4
ports.note: Speaker/line output, channel 4; same shared 8-pin Euroblock as Output 1/2/3

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Auto-sensing Fast Ethernet (IEEE 802.3u, 100 Mbit/s), star topology, for ArmoniaPlus remote control/monitoring

ports.name: Alarm/GPIO

ports.name: AC Mains In
ports.note: IEC 60320 C20 panel inlet (20A max, mates with a C19 cord), 100-240VAC 50/60Hz universal PFC/SRM switch-mode supply; region-specific detachable cord provided
